newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S-E-Banken, Nordbanken up on merger report.
newsitem.headline: S-E-Banken, Nordbanken up on merger report.

text.p: Shares in Swedish banks S-E-Banken and state-controlled Nordbanken rose on a report in Swedish newspaper Dagens Nyheter that the two were planning a merger that would be announced next week.

Bucking the negative trend on the Stockholm bourse, S-E-Banken traded at 70 crowns at 0835 GMT, up two on Thursday's closing price, while Nordbanken had risen 9.5 crowns to 224.5. The bourse's general index was down 0.78 percent to 2,511.35.
"The share price movements reflect the fact that merger speculation is more tangible now (after the newspaper article)," said a trader with a Stockholm bank.

Citing sources, Dagens Nyheter said signs that a merger is about to happen include reports that investments from both banks have been stopped and top managers from S-E-Banken have been asked to cancel travel plans.
Contacted by Reuters, neither bank would comment on the report.
